hookText: springrep, an exact B-rep CAD kernel in safe Rust, plus

beats.say: Springcraft open-sourced springrep, a dependency-free B-rep CAD kernel in safe Rust that compiles to WebAssembly, along with brep-conformance, a kernel-agnostic test suite for CAD modeling operations.
Built for robot-part CAD, springrep handles booleans, fillets, chamfers, sweeps, lofts, shells, offsets, STEP and exact measurements on analytic and NURBS surfaces, accurate to 1e-7 mm.
The MIT-licensed brep-conformance suite takes expected answers from closed forms and exact geometry; the author says it caught hundreds of bugs his own tests missed.
